theory.intro: A bearing gives a direction from one point to another, seen from directly above. The same direction can be written as a true bearing or as a compass bearing, and the question says which.
facts: For the opposite direction, **add** $180^{\circ}$ below $180^{\circ}$, or **subtract** $180^{\circ}$ at $180^{\circ}$ or above. For example, $180^{\circ}\text{T}$ becomes $000^{\circ}\text{T}$.
steps: Decide which quadrant the direction lies in.
Measure the angle from north or from south.
Write the bearing in the form the question asks for.

workedExamples.solution_text:
(a) North to east is $90^{\circ}$.
$90^{\circ}-28^{\circ}=62^{\circ}$
The true bearing is $062^{\circ}\text{T}$.
The turn from north is towards east, so the compass bearing is $\text{N}62^{\circ}\text{E}$.

(b) The marked turn starts at north and goes towards west.
The compass bearing is $\text{N}73^{\circ}\text{W}$.
The clockwise turn from north is $360^{\circ}-73^{\circ}=287^{\circ}$.
The true bearing is $287^{\circ}\text{T}$.

workedExamples.question_text:
(a) Write $\text{S}58^{\circ}\text{W}$ as a three-figure true bearing.
(b) Write $314^{\circ}\text{T}$ as a compass bearing.
(c) Explain why $\text{E}37^{\circ}\text{N}$ is not written as a valid compass bearing, and write the same direction correctly.
workedExamples.solution_text:
(a) Start at south and turn towards west.
$180^{\circ}+58^{\circ}=238^{\circ}$
The true bearing is $238^{\circ}\text{T}$.

(b) $314^{\circ}\text{T}$ lies between west and north.
$360^{\circ}-314^{\circ}=46^{\circ}$
The compass bearing is $\text{N}46^{\circ}\text{W}$.

(c) A compass bearing starts from north or south, not east.
$90^{\circ}-37^{\circ}=53^{\circ}$
The same direction is $\text{N}53^{\circ}\text{E}$.

workedExamples.question_text:
(a) The bearing of a jetty from a lookout is $147^{\circ}\text{T}$. Write the bearing of the lookout from the jetty as a three-figure true bearing and as a compass bearing.
(b) A boat travels on a compass bearing of $\text{N}64^{\circ}\text{W}$. Write the true bearing of its reverse course.
workedExamples.solution_text:
(a) The reverse direction is half a revolution away.
$147^{\circ}+180^{\circ}=327^{\circ}$
The true bearing is $327^{\circ}\text{T}$.
$360^{\circ}-327^{\circ}=33^{\circ}$
The compass bearing is $\text{N}33^{\circ}\text{W}$.

(b) First write the compass bearing as a true bearing.
$360^{\circ}-64^{\circ}=296^{\circ}$
Then subtract $180^{\circ}$ for the reverse direction.
$296^{\circ}-180^{\circ}=116^{\circ}$
The reverse course is $116^{\circ}\text{T}$.

workedExamples.question_text:
(a) A true bearing is $a^{\circ}$, where $0^{\circ}<a^{\circ}<180^{\circ}$. Write an expression for the true bearing of the opposite direction.
(b) A true bearing is $b^{\circ}$, where $180^{\circ}<b^{\circ}<360^{\circ}$. Write an expression for the true bearing of the opposite direction.
workedExamples.solution_text:
The opposite direction is half a revolution away.

(a) Add $180^{\circ}$ to keep the bearing between $0^{\circ}$ and $360^{\circ}$.
The opposite bearing is $(a+180)^{\circ}\text{T}$.

(b) Subtract $180^{\circ}$ to keep the bearing between $0^{\circ}$ and $360^{\circ}$.
The opposite bearing is $(b-180)^{\circ}\text{T}$.

foundation.question_text: Convert the compass bearing $\text{N}50^{\circ}\text{E}$ to a three-figure true bearing.
foundation.solution_text:
The turn starts at north and goes $50^{\circ}$ towards the east.
$\text{N}50^{\circ}\text{E}$
$=050^{\circ}\text{T}$

foundation.question_text: Convert the compass bearing $\text{S}20^{\circ}\text{E}$ to a three-figure true bearing.
foundation.solution_text:
Due south is $180^{\circ}$, and the turn of $20^{\circ}$ towards the east comes back before it.
$\text{S}20^{\circ}\text{E}$
$=180^{\circ}-20^{\circ}$
$=160^{\circ}\text{T}$

foundation.question_text: Convert the compass bearing $\text{S}47^{\circ}\text{W}$ to a three-figure true bearing.
foundation.solution_text:
Due south is $180^{\circ}$, and the turn of $47^{\circ}$ towards the west continues clockwise past it.
$\text{S}47^{\circ}\text{W}$
$=180^{\circ}+47^{\circ}$
$=227^{\circ}\text{T}$

foundation.question_text: Convert the compass bearing $\text{N}40^{\circ}\text{W}$ to a three-figure true bearing.
foundation.solution_text:
A full revolution is $360^{\circ}$, and the turn of $40^{\circ}$ towards the west stops that much short of north.
$\text{N}40^{\circ}\text{W}$
$=360^{\circ}-40^{\circ}$
$=320^{\circ}\text{T}$

foundation.question_text:
A navigator is told a direction is "$40^{\circ}$".
Explain why this is not correctly written as a true bearing, and write it correctly.
foundation.solution_text:
A true bearing is always written with three digits, so a two-digit reading is incomplete and could be misheard.
Written correctly, the direction is $040^{\circ}\text{T}$.

foundation.question_text: Explain why $\text{E}40^{\circ}\text{N}$ is not a valid compass bearing, and write the same direction as a valid compass bearing.
foundation.solution_text:
A compass bearing must start the turn at north or at south, never at east or west.
The direction is $40^{\circ}$ north of east, which is $50^{\circ}$ east of north.
Written correctly, the direction is $\text{N}50^{\circ}\text{E}$.

development.solution_text:
The marked angle is measured from north and $A$ lies to the west of the north line.
The compass bearing is $\text{N}62^{\circ}\text{W}$.

The marked angle is measured from south and $A$ lies to the east of the north–south line.
The compass bearing is $\text{S}38^{\circ}\text{E}$.

East to south is $90^{\circ}$, so the angle from south is $90^{\circ}-32^{\circ}=58^{\circ}$.
The turn from south is towards east.
The compass bearing is $\text{S}58^{\circ}\text{E}$.

The marked angle is measured from north and $A$ lies to the east of the north line.
The compass bearing is $\text{N}12^{\circ}\text{E}$.

West to north is $90^{\circ}$, so the angle from north is $90^{\circ}-23^{\circ}=67^{\circ}$.
The turn from north is towards west.
The compass bearing is $\text{N}67^{\circ}\text{W}$.

The marked angle is measured from south and $A$ lies to the west of the north–south line.
The compass bearing is $\text{S}23^{\circ}\text{W}$.

development.question_text:
The bearing of a radio mast from a farmhouse is $123^{\circ}\text{T}$.
Write the bearing of the farmhouse from the radio mast as a three-figure true bearing.
development.solution_text:
The opposite direction is half a revolution away, and $123^{\circ}$ is less than $180^{\circ}$, so add $180^{\circ}$.
$123^{\circ}+180^{\circ}$
$=303^{\circ}\text{T}$

development.question_text:
The bearing of a weather station from an airstrip is $231^{\circ}\text{T}$.
Write the bearing of the airstrip from the weather station as a three-figure true bearing.
development.solution_text:
Adding $180^{\circ}$ would give more than $360^{\circ}$, so subtract $180^{\circ}$ instead.
$231^{\circ}-180^{\circ}$
$=051^{\circ}\text{T}$

mastery.question_text:
A true bearing is $a^{\circ}$, where $180^{\circ}<a^{\circ}<360^{\circ}$.
Write an expression for the true bearing of the opposite direction.
mastery.solution_text:
The opposite direction is half a revolution away, so it is $a+180$ or $a-180$, whichever lands between $0^{\circ}$ and $360^{\circ}$.
Since $a>180$, adding $180$ would give more than $360$.
$a-180$

mastery.question_text:
A yacht's course is described by the compass bearing $\text{S}72^{\circ}\text{W}$.
Write the true bearing of the reverse course as a three-figure true bearing.

The bearing of a lighthouse from a trawler is $287^{\circ}\text{T}$.
Write the bearing of the trawler from the lighthouse as a three-figure true bearing.
mastery.solution_text:
The opposite direction is half a revolution away. Since $287^{\circ}$ is greater than $180^{\circ}$, subtract $180^{\circ}$.
$287^{\circ}-180^{\circ}=107^{\circ}$
The bearing is $107^{\circ}\text{T}$.

mastery.question_text:
The bearing of a ship from a port is $164^{\circ}\text{T}$.
Write the bearing of the port from the ship as a three-figure true bearing.
mastery.solution_text:
The opposite direction is half a revolution away. Since $164^{\circ}$ is less than $180^{\circ}$, add $180^{\circ}$.
$164^{\circ}+180^{\circ}=344^{\circ}$
The bearing is $344^{\circ}\text{T}$.
